quotes.text: Frant and Etchingham [station buildings] are more flamboyantly gothic and are built of ragstone.
quotes.reference: 1957 August 25, H. P. White, “The Tonbridge-Hastings Line and its Traffic”, in Railway Magazine, page 529:

quotes.text: By now South Koreans understand Pyongyang’s logic and know North Korea is highly unlikely to make good on its gothic threats.
